# e2e_container_registry (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing E2E Container Registry project.

~> **Migration Notice**: This data source has parameter changes in v3.0.0. See the [v3.0.0 Upgrade Guide](../guides/upgrade-to-v3.md#affected-resources) for migration instructions.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

## Example Usage

```hcl
data "e2e_container_registry" "registry" {
  region     = "Delhi NCR"  # Use 'region' instead of deprecated 'location'
  project_id = "12345"
  id         = "registry-12345"
}

# Use the retrieved registry information
output "registry_status" {
  value = data.e2e_container_registry.registry.status
}
```

## Schema

### Argument Reference

- `id` (Required) (String) The unique ID of the Container Registry project.
- `project_id` (Required) (String) The project ID under which the Container Registry is created.
- `region` (Required) (String) Region where the Container Registry is deployed. This is the standard parameter name for specifying the location.
- `location` (Optional, **Deprecated**) (String) **DEPRECATED**: Use 'region' instead. This parameter will be removed in version 3.0.0. The location where the Container Registry is deployed.

### Read-Only

- `project_name` (String) Name of the Container Registry project.
- `status` (String) Current operational status of the Container Registry.
- `severity` (String) Vulnerability severity level configured for image scans (e.g., "low", "medium", "high", "critical").
- `prevent_vul` (Boolean) Whether pushing vulnerable container images is prevented.

### Computed (Deprecated)

- `setup_status` (String, **Deprecated**) **DEPRECATED**: Use 'status' instead. This parameter will be removed in version 3.0.0. Current setup status of the Container Registry. This is a computed attribute that mirrors `status`.
